senses.cnFull: 用于男子的姓或姓名前

sentences.en: My teacher is from the USA.
The rabbit has a short tail.
The elephant has a big body.

Let's sing a song for her.
I can see with my eyes.
I can smell with my nose.
I can taste with my tongue.
I can touch with my hand.

sentences.en: I have an egg and some rice.
The ball is under the box.
The doll is on the shelf.
The car is in the box.
Put the map on the shelf.
This old boat is so cool.

sentences.cn: 我仍然保留着我的旧玩具。
sentences.en: I still keep my old toys.
